name: apply_scale_deployment
description: Apply a replica change previously returned by plan_scale_deployment. Arguments must match the plan exactly. The plan is single-use, expires after a few minutes, and is rejected if the Deployment changed since planning.

replicas.description: Desired replica count; must equal the planned value.

override_manual_change.description: Must equal the value given to plan_scale_deployment (default false).

name: apply_restart_deployment
description: Apply a restart previously returned by plan_restart_deployment: every pod of the Deployment is replaced, replicas stay as they are. Arguments must match the plan exactly. The plan is single-use, expires after a few minutes, and is rejected if the Deployment changed since planning.

name: apply_rollback_deployment
description: Apply a rollback previously returned by plan_rollback_deployment: the Deployment's pod template is set to exactly the template of the ReplicaSet the plan pinned, replicas stay as they are. Arguments must match the plan exactly. The plan is single-use, expires after a few minutes, and is rejected if the Deployment changed since planning, or the pinned ReplicaSet was removed (revision_not_found), replaced or edited.

revision.description: Revision; must equal the planned value.

override_manual_change.description: Must equal the value given to plan_rollback_deployment (default false).
